rule.message:
All students must complete the University's  Liberal Education requirements.
Collegiate Requirements:
All incoming CLA first-year (freshmen) must complete the First-Year Experience course sequence.
All incoming CLA first-year (freshmen) students earning a BA, BS, or BIS degree must complete CLA 3002 or another approved career or internship course (CLA 3101, CLA 3201, CLA 3301, CLA 3896, or CLA 3996.
All students must complete a capstone in at least one CLA major. The requirements for double majors completing the capstone in a different CLA major will be clearly stated. Students must also complete all major requirements in both majors to allow the additional capstone to be waived. Students completing an additional degree must complete the Capstone in each degree area.
At least 14 upper-division credits in the major must be taken at the University of Minnesota Twin Cities campus.
Students may earn up to one undergraduate degree in the geography program: a BA, a BS, or a minor. Students in the Geography BS may also seek a major or minor in urban studies, or the minor in geographic information sciences. Students who declare the Geographic Information Science sub-plan in the BS may not minor in Geographic Information Science.
View sample plans for this program here: https://sampleplan.umn.edu/node/466 Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.
Complete any sub-plan requirements that apply to you: Environmental Geography, Geographic Information Science, Human Geography. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.
